blurb: Will Eastcott is a veteran graphics programmer and co-founder of PlayCanvas, a WebGL game engine. He previously worked at Criterion Software on the RenderWare engine, contributing to Dreamcast titles. He posts about real-time graphics, WebGPU, and game development. His follower count is not publicly available due to X restrictions.
